 Brazoria County District Court
 Cause No. 2024-CV-0032
 Matthew Gregory, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Plaintiff's Original Petition
Filed:
November 9, 2024
Plaintiff's counsel:
Joseph Miller, Paul & Kline Injury Lawyers
PARTIES
Plaintiff Matthew Gregory is an individual residing in Texas who was the driver of a vehicle involved in the collision described
below. Defendant is an automobile insurance company authorized to write policies in the State of Texas and doing business in
Katy, Texas. Defendant may be served through its registered agent for service of process.
FACTS
On November 23, 2023, Plaintiff was lawfully operating his vehilce on a public roadway in Katy, Texas, when another vehicle
traveling in the opposite direction crossed into Plaintiff's lane and collided head-on with Plaintiff's vehicle. The ipmact was at low
speed, but it was sufficient to force Plaintiff's knee against the dashboard and interior components of his vehicle. Plaintiff
submitted a claim under the personal injury protection and uninsured or underinsured motorist coverages of his policy with
Defendant. Defendant has not paid the benefits owed under those coverages in an amount sufficient to cover Plaintiff's losses.
NEGLIGENCE
Defendant owed Plaintiff a duty to investigate his claim promptly and fairly, to evaluate the claim in good faith, and to pay
benefits due under the policy. Defendant breached these duties by delaying its investigation, failing to give Plaintiff a reasonable
explanation for its position, and undervaluing the injury despite medical records doucmenting the knee trauma. Such conduct
violates the Texas Insurance Code and the Texas Deceptive Trade Practices Act.
DAMAGES
As a direct result of the collision and Defendant's conduct, Plaintiff has suffered a knee injury requiring medical treatment,
physical therapy, and time away from work, along with pain, suffering, and loss of enjoyment of life. Plaintiff seeks actual
damages, statutory penalties, attorney's fees, and court costs. Plaintiff therefore demands judgment against Defendant in the
amount of $226,000.00, plus pre-judgment and post-judgment interest as allowed by law.
